title: Digital receivable processed successfully
description: Emitted as the digital_receivable_processed_success event type (schema version 2) once per affected digital receivable when a lifecycle operation succeeds: a digital receivable update (RECEIVABLE/UPDATE), a bill protest creation or withdrawal (BILL_PROTEST/CREATE or BILL_PROTEST/WITHDRAW), a settlement (SETTLEMENT/CREATE) or a debtor claim (DEBTOR_CLAIM/CREATE). The feature_type field tells which variant block (bill_protest, settlement or debtor_claim) is present, and digital_receivable always carries the receivable snapshot after the operation, so consumers can keep their own view of the receivable and its events up to date.

feature_type.title: Feature type
feature_type.description: Domain affected by the operation, serialized from the FeatureTypeV2 enum; it discriminates which variant block is present in the event. RECEIVABLE: digital receivable update, no variant block. CONTRACT: contract operation (not emitted in this version). INSTRUMENT_ACT: negotiable instrument act operation (not emitted in this version). SETTLEMENT: settlement of the digital receivable, settlement block present. DEBTOR_CLAIM: claim registered by the debtor, debtor_claim block present. BILL_PROTEST: bill protest created or withdrawn, bill_protest block present.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Operation performed within the feature_type, serialized from the OperationTypeV2 enum. CREATE: a new record (bill protest, settlement or debtor claim) was created. UPDATE: the digital receivable was updated. DELETE: a record was deleted. WITHDRAW: the bill protest was withdrawn. UPDATE_INCL: inclusion update. UPDATE_ALTE: alteration update. UPDATE_EXCL: exclusion update. CANCELLATION_ERROR: cancellation due to an operational error. CLOSING: closing without a specific reason. CLOSING_DJUD: closing by court decision. CLOSING_RNGC: closing by renegotiation. CLOSING_ENEP: closing by ENEP termination reason. CLOSING_ENEM: closing by ENEM termination reason. CLOSING_ENES: closing by ENES termination reason.

digital_receivable.title: Digital receivable
digital_receivable.description: Snapshot of the digital receivable as stored by Pismo after the operation was applied. Nested fields that are null or empty are omitted.

id.title: Digital receivable ID
id.description: Client-provided identifier of the digital receivable, unique per organization.

face_value.title: Face value
face_value.description: Current face value of the digital receivable in BRL, with decimals.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Current maturity date of the digital receivable, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

situation_type.title: Situation type
situation_type.description: Lifecycle situation of the digital receivable, serialized from the DigitalReceivableSituationType enum. ACTIVE: the receivable is live and can be operated. BLOCKED: the receivable is live but blocked for operations. COMPLETED: the receivable was fully settled. INACTIVE: the receivable is no longer active.

reason_type.title: Reason type
reason_type.description: Reason behind the current situation_type of the digital receivable, from the ReasonType enum. LIVR: Livre, free of restrictions and available for negotiation. BLOQ: Comprometida, committed to a contract or negotiable instrument act. BQSD: Bloqueada pelo sacador, blocked by the drawer (lender). BQCJ: Bloqueada por constrição judicial, blocked by a court order. COMT: Completada, the receivable is settled. Omitted when the receivable has no reason set.

document_number.title: Lender document number
document_number.description: Unformatted CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the lender, as provided by the client.

document_number.title: Debtor document number
document_number.description: Unformatted CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the debtor, as provided by the client.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Current owner of the digital receivable; it changes when a contract assigns or endorses the receivable. Fields that are not set are omitted.

type.title: Owner type
type.description: Ownership code set by Pismo: OWNR when the receivable is held by its original owner, CESS after an assignment and ENDS after an endorsement.

document_number.title: Owner document number
document_number.description: Unformatted CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the current owner; omitted when not set.

name.title: Owner name
name.description: Name of the current owner; omitted when not set.

beneficiary.title: Beneficiary
beneficiary.description: Current beneficiary of the digital receivable effects, set from the linked contract type. Fields that are not set are omitted.

type.title: Beneficiary type
type.description: Beneficiary code set by Pismo: OWNR by default, EDPN for endorsement pledge effect, CEFD for fiduciary cession effect and PENR for pledge effect.

document_number.title: Beneficiary document number
document_number.description: Unformatted CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the beneficiary; omitted when not set.

name.title: Beneficiary name
name.description: Name of the beneficiary; omitted when not set.

contract.title: Contract
contract.description: Contract linked to the digital receivable. Only filled for SETTLEMENT and DEBTOR_CLAIM events, and omitted when the receivable has no contract.

id.title: Contract ID
id.description: Identifier of the contract linked to the digital receivable.

operation_id.title: Contract operation ID
operation_id.description: Client-provided operation identifier of the contract linked to the digital receivable.

instrument_act.title: Instrument act
instrument_act.description: Negotiable instrument acts linked to the digital receivable. Only filled for SETTLEMENT and DEBTOR_CLAIM events, and omitted when the receivable has no linked act.

ids.title: Instrument act IDs
ids.description: Client-provided IDs of all negotiable instrument acts linked to the digital receivable, sorted in ascending order.

processed_id.title: Processed instrument act ID
processed_id.description: First ID of the ids list in ascending order; currently it is not derived from the operation itself.

bill_protest.title: Bill protest
bill_protest.description: Bill protest that was created or withdrawn. Present only when feature_type is BILL_PROTEST; null or empty fields are omitted.

registry_office_name.title: Registry office name
registry_office_name.description: Client-provided name of the registry office where the bill was protested, up to 100 characters.
examples: 1º Tabelião de Protesto de São Paulo

date.title: Protest date
date.description: Client-provided date the bill was protested, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd; omitted when not informed.

discharge_date.title: Discharge date
discharge_date.description: Date the protest was discharged, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd; omitted while the protest is not discharged.

payable_amount.title: Payable amount
payable_amount.description: Client-provided total amount in BRL, with decimals, payable to discharge the protest; always positive.

abatement_amount.title: Abatement amount
abatement_amount.description: Abatement amount in BRL, with decimals, granted on the protested bill; omitted when not informed.

penalty_amount.title: Penalty amount
penalty_amount.description: Penalty amount in BRL, with decimals, charged on the protested bill; omitted when not informed.

interest_amount.title: Interest amount
interest_amount.description: Interest amount in BRL, with decimals, charged on the protested bill; omitted when not informed.

fee_amount.title: Fee amount
fee_amount.description: Registry office fee amount in BRL, with decimals, charged on the protested bill; omitted when not informed.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.description: Settlement applied to the digital receivable. Present only when feature_type is SETTLEMENT; null or empty fields are omitted.

type.title: Settlement type
type.description: Kind of settlement, serialized from the SettlementType enum. ADVANCE_PAYMENT: paid before the maturity date. ON_TIME_PAYMENT: paid on the maturity date. ARREARS_PAYMENT: paid after the maturity date. DISCOUNT_PAYMENT: paid with a discount. PARTIAL_PAYMENT: only part of the face value was paid. CANCELLATION: the receivable was settled by cancellation. OVERPAYMENT: paid above the face value.

date.title: Settlement date
date.description: Liquidation date informed for the settlement, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd; omitted when not informed.

value.title: Settlement value
value.description: Amount in BRL, with decimals, paid in this settlement; omitted when not informed.

current_face_value.title: Current face value
current_face_value.description: Face value of the digital receivable in BRL, with decimals, recorded with the settlement; omitted when not set.

remaining_value.title: Remaining value
remaining_value.description: Amount in BRL, with decimals, still owed on the digital receivable after this settlement; omitted when not set.

debtor_claim.title: Debtor claim
debtor_claim.description: Claim registered by the debtor against the digital receivable. Present only when feature_type is DEBTOR_CLAIM; null or empty fields are omitted.

claim_type.title: Claim type
claim_type.description: Client-provided debtor claim (manifestação do sacado) over the receivable, from the ClaimType enum. ACTO: accepted by the debtor. RCAV: refused, damaged goods. RCQQ: refused, different quantity or quality. RCVN: refused, sale not completed. RCVL: refused, different amount. RCOP: refused, other problems. ANTC: early payment (antecipação) requested by the debtor.

date.title: Claim date
date.description: Client-provided date of the claim, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd; omitted when not informed.

face_value.title: Claimed face value
face_value.description: Face value in BRL, with decimals, that the debtor claims for the receivable; omitted when not informed.

maturity_date.title: Claimed maturity date
maturity_date.description: Maturity date that the debtor claims for the receivable, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd; omitted when not informed.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text justification of the claim provided by the client, up to 255 characters; omitted when not informed.

receipt_indicator.title: Receipt indicator
receipt_indicator.description: Client-provided flag telling whether the debtor confirms receipt of the goods or services; omitted when not informed.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Payment instruments of the settlement. Only the first instrument of each kind is sent, and kinds without an instrument are omitted.

bank_slip.title: Bank slip
bank_slip.description: First bank slip (boleto) registered for the payment.

bar_code.title: Bar code
bar_code.description: Bar code number of the bank slip, digits only.

pix.title: PIX
pix.description: First PIX key registered for the payment.

type.title: PIX key type
type.description: Numeric code of the PIX key type, taken from the PixType enum value. 1: CPF key. 2: CNPJ key. 3: phone number key. 4: email key. 5: random key. 6: copy and paste (QR code) key.

value.title: PIX key value
value.description: Value of the PIX key, in the format of its key type.

ted.title: TED
ted.description: First bank account registered for TED transfers.

ispb.title: ISPB
ispb.description: ISPB code (8 digits) identifying the receiving financial institution.

compe.title: COMPE
compe.description: COMPE bank code (3 digits) of the receiving financial institution.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Bank branch number of the receiving account, without check digit.

account_number.title: Account number
account_number.description: Number of the receiving bank account, without check digit.

account_digit.title: Account digit
account_digit.description: Check digit of the receiving bank account.

account_type.title: Account type
account_type.description: Type code of the receiving bank account, as provided by the client.

owner_account_document_number.title: Account owner document number
owner_account_document_number.description: Unformatted CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the bank account owner.
